newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine says Yankee bond details due Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Philippine says Yankee bond details due Wednesday.

text.p: Terms of the Philippine Yankee bond are due to be announced later on Wednesday instead of Tuesday as originally scheduled, Philippine Central Bank treasury head Sergio Edeza said on Wednesday.

"I was just advised yesterday that it will be announced on Wednesday New York time (April 16). They were waiting for a particular U.S. economic number that might affect the interest rate," Edeza told Reuters.
Edeza declined to give likely details on the terms.
Edeza said he was unaware of reports of any delay but noted that top central bank officials were still in New York for the bond's roadshow.
Standard & Poor's on Tuesday rated the planned issue BB minus with a positive outlook.
